license_note: The pinned Hugging Face dataset declares no license. NOASSERTION does not block analysis, but raw redistribution and training-right claims remain out of scope.
known_selection_bias: The publisher removed empty, crashed, repeated-API-failure, and truncated trajectories.
All but 61 removed trajectories had reward zero.
Retained-only data cannot estimate natural failure or infrastructure-failure prevalence.
split_policy: group all passes sharing benchmark, domain, task_id, and source_model
keep benchmark task families and near duplicates in one fold
never describe independent passes as user learning
report each benchmark before any pooled estimate
